title: Fatou selection of a good level and a bounded subsequence
statement: Let g_k : ℝ → [0, ∞] (k ∈ ℕ) be measurable functions, a < b real numbers, C ∈ [0, ∞] with C < ∞ and ∫⁻_{(a,b)} g_k(t) dt ≤ C for every k, and E ⊆ ℝ countable. Then there are γ ∈ (a, b) with γ ∉ E, a strictly increasing σ : ℕ → ℕ and G ∈ [0, ∞] with G < ∞ such that g_{σ(k)}(γ) ≤ G for every k.
lean_statement: ∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (a b : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (E : Set ℝ), a < b → (∀ k, Measurable (g k)) → C < ∞ → (∀ k, ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g k t ≤ C) → E.Countable → ∃ (γ : ℝ) (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : ℝ≥0∞), γ ∈ Ioo a b ∧ γ ∉ E ∧ StrictMono σ ∧ G < ∞ ∧ ∀ k, g (σ k) γ ≤ G
